title.native: 天幕のジャードゥーガル

description:
After losing her mother and her homeland, Sitara’s despair transforms into determination with the power of knowledge. New possibilities unfold when a family of scholars takes her in, deepening her education. Meanwhile, Genghis Khan’s Mongol Empire conquers nation after nation, nearing Sitara’s new home. After the Fourth Prince of the empire takes her captive, a flame of revenge is ignited.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

node.description:
A lonely girl who lost her mother and was torn far from her homeland.
Taken in by a family of scholars, she lives peacefully while gaining wisdom—only to lose everything when the Mongol Empire invades.

[Ögedei’s](https://anilist.co/character/399632/gedei) sixth wife.

She harbors a deep hatred for the Mongol Empire and sees her husband as an enemy.

After meeting [Sitara](https://anilist.co/character/328089/Sitara), she resolves to stand against the empire alongside her.

[Ögedei's](https://anilist.co/character/399632/gedei) first wife and Empress (the Great Khatun). Always calm, composed, and dignified, she is a woman of unfathomable depth. Believing that "in politics, it is crucial to pull strings beneath the surface," she secretly devises strategies, deeply concerned about the empire's future and the imbalance of power.

[Tolui's](https://anilist.co/character/380761/Tolui) wife. She believes that "the world is wider than the steppe," and is searching for "Elements," a text containing knowledge from the West. She also possesses great insight, recognizing the danger that comes with imbalances in military strength and authority.

Son of Emperor [Genghis Khan](https://anilist.co/character/403366/) and the fourth prince of the Mongol Empire.
Possessing the greatest share of the empire's military strength, he uses this power to invade other nations.

[Fatima](https://anilist.co/character/394598/)'s son and a brilliant young boy in his own right.
He teaches young [Sitara](https://anilist.co/character/328089/) the importance of learning, and sets out on a journey to encounter all kinds of wisdom and to search for the truth.

The third son of [Genghis Khan](https://anilist.co/character/403366/), emperor of the Mongol Empire.

Thoughtful and observant, he is known for his calm and generous nature.

With a broad and far-sighted perspective, he strives for the prosperity of the empire.

A young boy captured by the Mongol Empire.
Shrewd by nature, he curries favor with Tolui in hopes of survival and rising in status.

[Muhammad](https://anilist.co/character/394597/)’s mother and kind-hearted lady of the house.
She takes in the utterly alone Sitara and cherishes her as if she were her own child.

[Ögedei's](https://anilist.co/character/399632/gedei) fourth wife, who deeply adores [Boraqchin.](https://anilist.co/character/403710/Boraqchin) While she proclaims that she "isn't very smart," she has an innocent and honest personality.
Daiyr's daughter. A bright and innocent girl whose proud and strong spirit allows her to protect everyone when her tribe is in danger.

The second son of [Genghis Khan](https://anilist.co/character/403366/), emperor of the Mongol Empire.

Though strict and disciplined, he values law and order because of his kindhearted desire to protect slaves and ordinary people.
A female slave who has long served at the estate in Tus. With a kind personality, she teaches Sitara how to bake bread, among other things.

name.native: ニケライ ファラナーゼ

node.description: A female slave who serves at the estate in Tus. Gifted at cleaning, she's a kind and dependable older sister figure to Sitara.
A Uyghur and former merchant serving the Mongol Empire.

The eldest son of Genghis Khan, emperor of the Mongol Empire.

As the eldest of the four brothers, he has a quiet and gentle nature.

[Ögedei's](https://anilist.co/character/399632/gedei) third wife. Incredibly emotional, she is very sweet towards Ögedei but makes no effort to hide her feelings of rivalry towards the other wives. Her drastic mood swings often lead her to lose composure and cause a scene when something goes awry.

A Merkit chief and shaman (Kam) who is capable of communicating with spirits. Despite their large age gap, he warmly welcomes Töregene as his wife for the sake of an alliance against the Mongols. He is a thoughtful and prudent man who consults the spirits and makes a painful decision as a crisis looms over his tribe.

alternative: Fatima no Ani (ファーティマの兄)

node.description: Fatima's older brother. A qualified teacher, he instructs Sitara and the other children in reciting the Quran at the estate.
Temüge was the youngest brother of [Genghis Khan](https://anilist.co/character/403366/), fourth son of Yesugei.

Kublai is the second son of [Tolui](https://anilist.co/character/380761/) by his chief wife [Sorghaghtani Beki](https://anilist.co/character/403707/), and a grandson of [Genghis Khan](https://anilist.co/character/403366/).

A boy known by many for his aptitude with the bow. Close friends with Khulan and Töregene, he carries a childlike innocence and vulnerability that shows his age. Even so, he chooses to fight with his allies against the Mongol threat.
[Zumurrud](https://anilist.co/character/403348/)'s brother.

As a son of [Tolui](https://anilist.co/character/380761/) and the Keraite princess [Sorghaghtani Beki](https://anilist.co/character/403707/), he was a grandson of [Genghis Khan](https://anilist.co/character/403366/) and brother of Ariq Böke, Möngke Khan, and [Kublai Khan](https://anilist.co/character/404551/Kublai).
[Temüge](https://anilist.co/character/404548/)'s son.
[Jochi](https://anilist.co/character/399634/)'s eldest son.
[Jochi](https://anilist.co/character/399634/)'s second son.
